body: Disappointment is what we feel when life does not match our hopes, like losing a job or missing a chance we really wanted.
失望，就是生活没有达到我们的期望时的感受，比如丢了工作，或错过了一个特别想要的机会。
Instead of hiding the feeling, experts suggest we name it, accept it, and give ourselves time to feel sad before moving on.
专家建议不要藏起这种情绪，而是先说出它、接受它，给自己一点难过的时间，再继续前行。
Talking to friends, lowering unrealistic expectations and focusing on small next steps can slowly turn disappointment into a fresh start.
和朋友聊聊、放下不切实际的期待、专注于下一小步，能慢慢把失望变成一个新的开始。
Many people find the sound of rain deeply relaxing, and some even play recorded rain sounds to help them sleep at night.
很多人觉得雨声特别让人放松，有人晚上甚至会播放雨声录音来帮助入睡。
Scientists say rain produces gentle, steady noise that masks sudden sounds, which helps our busy brains slow down and rest.
科学家说，雨声是一种轻柔而平稳的声音，能盖住突然的噪音，让忙碌的大脑慢下来休息。
A rainy day also gives us permission to stay inside, drink something warm and simply watch the world without feeling guilty.
下雨天还给了我们一个'名正言顺'待在家的理由：喝杯热饮，安心看看窗外的世界，也不觉得内疚。
Breathing keeps us alive, but the way we breathe can also change how calm or stressed we feel during the day.
呼吸让我们活着，但呼吸的方式也会影响我们一天中是平静还是紧张。
Simple exercises, such as breathing in slowly and breathing out even more slowly, tell the body it is safe to relax.
一些简单的练习，比如慢慢吸气、再更慢地呼气，会告诉身体'现在很安全，可以放松了'。
Just a few minutes of breathwork before an interview or a difficult talk can lower stress and help us think more clearly.
面试或艰难谈话前，只需几分钟的呼吸练习，就能减压，让头脑更清醒。
Supermarket shelves are full of yoghurts, but many of them contain much more sugar than people expect from a healthy food.
超市货架上摆满了酸奶，但很多酸奶的含糖量远超人们对'健康食品'的想象。
Experts advise checking the label carefully: plain, natural yoghurt with live cultures is usually a better choice than sweet flavoured ones.
专家建议仔细看配料表：无糖的原味酸奶、含活性菌的，通常比甜味调味酸奶更好。
If plain yoghurt tastes too sour, adding fresh fruit or a little honey at home is a smarter way to make it sweet.
如果原味酸奶太酸，回家自己加点新鲜水果或少许蜂蜜，是更聪明的增甜方式。
New weight loss drugs like Ozempic have become world famous because they help people eat less by making them feel full sooner.
像 Ozempic 这样的新型减肥药在全球爆红，因为它们能让人更快产生饱腹感，从而少吃。
Doctors say these medicines can really help some patients, but they may bring side effects and the weight often returns after stopping.
医生表示，这类药确实能帮到一部分患者，但可能有副作用，而且停药后体重常常反弹。
Experts remind us that healthy food and regular movement are still the foundation, and no pill can fully replace a good lifestyle.
专家提醒：健康饮食和规律运动仍是根本，没有任何药片能完全取代好的生活方式。
